headline: TRITN surges 50.00% on a 6.5σ volume spike while XBIO opens with an 11.11% gap amid a subsidiary disposal filing.
market_take: The PROP and CONS sectors dominate today with multiple large price moves and volume spikes. Several stocks posted double‑digit gaps, notably TRITN (+50.00%) and XBIO (-11.11%). Recent filings highlight director changes at TEAMG, acquisition disposals at XBIO, and a high‑profile connected‑transaction review at SST.

sector_notes.note: XBIO opened down 11.11% and later rose 12.50% intraday, coinciding with a disposal filing; MADAME posted a 10.00% intraday rise, while AQUA fell 10.00%.
J and S led gains with +21.79% and +18.37% respectively, both on strong volume; KC dropped 33.33%.
TRITN jumped 50.00% on a 6.5σ volume spike; CNT and PLE added 13.66% and 12.50% respectively.
M‑STOR fell 9.14% despite low volume, while M‑PAT rose 6.00%.
